subject: general
question: What is the IUPAC name of tertiary butyl alcohol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2-Methylpropan-2-ol**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tertiary butyl alcohol (also known as t-BuOH)** is a type of alcohol with the** molecular formula C₄H₉OH.**</li
